title: Why Earning More Rarely Makes You Feel Rich #Shorts
description:
Your income doubles and your savings do not. This has a name, and almost everyone falls for it.

You cannot out-earn an unbounded lifestyle. The only lever that works is deciding, in advance, what enough looks like.

scenes.narration: Your income doubles and your savings do not. This has a name, and almost everyone falls for it.
Lifestyle creep is the quiet upgrade of your baseline. Each step feels reasonable alone and resets what a normal month costs.
Hedonic adaptation does the rest. Any improvement becomes normal within weeks, then starts feeling like the minimum.
Meanwhile fixed costs rise faster than income, so the gap between earning more and keeping more never closes.
The people who build wealth are usually not the highest earners. They are the ones whose lifestyle did not follow their income.
You cannot out-earn an unbounded lifestyle. The only lever that works is deciding, in advance, what enough looks like.
